remarks: Located in prime South Wilton just minutes from Westport and New Canaan, this exceptional colonial blends timeless New England charm with today's most sought-after amenities. Set back from the road on 1.1 private acres, the home has been expanded and upgraded to deliver scale and modern comfort. With four bedrooms and a flexible additional room plus abundant living space, the layout is ideal for both everyday life and entertaining. Architectural details, windows in every direction, and numerous recent enhancements create an atmosphere of sophisticated ease. The landscaped grounds include a gracious entry drive, a sweeping front lawn, and a fully fenced backyard anchored by a bluestone patio.  Improvements in the last two years include a remodeled studio (ideal for private office, gym, guest retreat, or creative workspace), extensive new flooring and paint, split-rail fencing in the backyard, brand-new propane heating system with Nest thermostats, custom ADT security system, and whole-house water filtration system to complement public water connection - delivering peace of mind and modern performance.   Located near the Merritt Parkway and Metro North, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy quality, privacy, and convenience in one of Fairfield County's most coveted settings.    Wilton Center - 7 min | Westport - 7 min | New Canaan - 15 min | Darien - 15 min | Cranbury Park (227 acre public park and trails) - 1 min
